title: Hybrid Documentation Strategy - Local Lean + RAG Complete
summary: Strategic approach to documentation: Keep only most recent milestone visible locally for developers, while storing complete historical knowledge in RAG vector database for crew reference. This creates lean developer experience while maintaining comprehensive AI crew access to full project history.
detailed_analysis: Current state still has excessive milestone documentation visible in file system. Optimal strategy: Local file system shows only current/recent milestones for developer visibility, while RAG vector database stores complete historical knowledge for crew semantic search. This serves two audiences optimally - developers get clean workspace, AI crew gets complete searchable history.
key_findings: Developers need clean, minimal file structure - excessive docs create cognitive overload
AI crew needs complete historical reference - RAG vector search provides this perfectly
Most recent milestone should be locally visible for quick human reference
Historical milestones should be RAG-accessible but not cluttering file system
Scripts and supporting files should follow same pattern - keep essentials, RAG store details
This hybrid approach serves both human and AI needs optimally
conclusions: Keep only 1-2 most recent milestones in visible file system
Store ALL milestones in RAG vector database with full searchability
Crew can query RAG for any historical milestone or learning
Developers see clean structure, crew see complete history
Same principle applies to scripts - keep active, RAG store documentation
This is the optimal balance between human UX and AI crew capabilities
recommendations: Store all milestone knowledge in RAG with semantic search
Create simple README in milestones/ explaining RAG access
Implement this pattern for all documentation going forward
general_principles: Hybrid documentation: Local shows recent/current, RAG stores complete history
Serve two audiences optimally: Developers need clean workspace, AI needs complete reference
Most recent milestone locally visible for quick human consultation
Complete historical knowledge in RAG vector database for semantic search
Delete file system clutter after RAG storage confirms knowledge preserved
Developer experience: minimal cognitive load through clean structure
AI crew experience: comprehensive knowledge access through RAG queries
Balance human readability with AI searchability through strategic storage location
applicable_scenarios: Any project with AI crew requiring historical reference but also needing clean developer workspace
Documentation systems serving both human developers and AI agents
Projects transitioning from file-based to RAG-based knowledge management
Systems where excessive files create developer confusion but historical knowledge valuable
Hybrid human-AI workflows requiring different information access patterns
